title: AI to lift people out of poverty
summary: SERA proposes AI models that personalize budgets, identify spending reductions, and suggest income opportunities. Changes in users’ finances are unmeasured.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: SERA proposes a Smart Budget service that analyzes financial transactions and uses language and predictive models to personalize budgets, identify spending reductions, and suggest localized income opportunities. Its model plan includes fine-tuning and feedback on financial guidance. Changes in users’ finances attributable to the AI are unmeasured. A separate debt-offset method moves available funds against credit-card balances, without an identified AI contribution.
purpose: Personalize budgeting and guidance about spending and income opportunities.

ratings.reason: AI budgeting and localized recommendations are intended to improve spending decisions and financial management. No resulting saving, income increase or debt reduction is measured.

ai_role.statement: The proposed AI analyzes spending and generates personalized financial guidance. The separate debt-offset financing principle does not establish an AI contribution to debt repayment.

evidence.citation: Project account in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. Outcomes are reported by the project team. The account provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 12: AI to lift people out of poverty

produced_by: Proposed language and predictive models for personalized budgeting and guidance
must_hold: Current localized financial and income-opportunity information
Review and monitoring of personalized financial recommendations

headline: SERA proposes AI budgeting and financial guidance
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
